name: DRS Kit
description: A full acoustic rock and jazz kit from DrumGizmo and DRSDrums: kick, snare, three toms, hi-hat, ride and two crashes, with round robins and many velocity layers.
author: Lars Muldjord, Bent Bisballe Nyeng and Jes Eiler (DRSDrums); SFZ mapping by kinwie
